subtitles.id: Mahasiswa Teknik Informatika & Full-stack Web Developer
subtitles.en: Informatics Engineering Student & Full-stack Web Developer

bio.id: Saya adalah seorang mahasiswa Teknik Informatika yang berfokus pada pengembangan web full-stack dan aplikasi mobile. Aktif dalam organisasi teknologi dan suka membangun solusi digital yang efisien.
bio.en: I am an Informatics Engineering student focusing on full-stack web development and mobile applications. Active in technology organizations and passionate about building efficient digital solutions.

description.id: Sistem operasional kafe berbasis Command Line Interface (CLI) yang mengadaptasi studi kasus riil dari salah satu kafe di Kota Bandung untuk manajemen pesanan terstruktur.
description.en: A Command Line Interface (CLI) based cafe operational system built from a real-world cafe case study in Bandung to handle structured order management.

description.id: Pengembangan lanjutan aplikasi kasir kafe berbasis Graphical User Interface (GUI) dengan integrasi basis data permanen untuk kebutuhan operasional acara Supergame internal UKM OXIGEN.
description.en: An advanced GUI-based cafe cashier application integrated with a persistent database for UKM OXIGEN's internal Supergame event operational needs.

description.id: Sistem informasi manajemen pemadam kebakaran terintegrasi. Bertindak sebagai Ketua Kelompok yang memimpin perancangan skema arsitektur basis data MySQL dan visualisasi workflow aplikasi.
description.en: An integrated fire department management information system. Served as Team Leader, orchestrating the MySQL database schema design and application workflow mapping.

description.id: Aplikasi pesan instan kelompok berbasis web. Memimpin tim backend untuk bermigrasi dari MongoDB ke Firebase Realtime Database demi mendukung sinkronisasi obrolan secara instan.
description.en: A team-developed instant messaging web application. Led the backend engineering to migrate from MongoDB to Firebase Realtime Database to achieve seamless chat synchronization.

projects.title: UKM English Club Management Web & LMS

description.id: Platform manajemen terpadu UKM EC yang mengintegrasikan landing page informasi, modul LMS materi berkas markdown, enkripsi token presensi Divisi Pendidikan, serta dashboard ekspor laporan pengurus.
description.en: An integrated UKM EC management platform combining an informational landing page, Markdown-powered LMS, token-secured attendance tracking, and administrative data export functionality.

description.id: Aplikasi web edukasi statis inovatif yang dirancang secara mandiri untuk memfasilitasi kebutuhan modul belajar dan kurikulum pemrograman bagi anggota baru di divisi software UKM OXIGEN.
description.en: An innovative static learning management portal independently designed to host programming syllabi and modular documentation for newly recruited members of the UKM OXIGEN software division.

description.id: Alat produktivitas personal berbasis lokal (localhost) untuk memotong waktu menyusun slide mengajar dengan memisahkan penulisan materi berformat Markdown dari kompilasi visual template.
description.en: A localized personal productivity tool crafted to accelerate teaching preparations by programmatically rendering presentation layouts directly from custom Markdown files.

organization.descId: Memimpin divisi software, menyusun roadmap pembelajaran web & mobile development, serta mengoordinasikan pelatihan internal dan mentor bagi anggota baru.
organization.descEn: Leading the software division, designing web & mobile development learning roadmaps, and coordinating internal training and mentoring for new members.

organization.descId: Merancang program edukasi komunitas, termasuk mengoordinasikan workshop teknologi terbaru seperti pengenalan tren kecerdasan buatan (AI).
organization.descEn: Designing community educational programs, including coordinating workshops on the latest technology trends such as artificial intelligence (AI).

organization.descId: Mengelola komunikasi eksternal organisasi, menjembatani hubungan antar lembaga kampus, dan mendukung penyebaran informasi kegiatan klub.
organization.descEn: Managing external organizational communication, bridging relationships between campus institutions, and supporting the dissemination of club activities information.

committee.company: Talkshow & Workshop: Transformasi Coding Era AI
committee.descId: Memimpin kepanitiaan dalam menyelenggarakan talkshow teknologi yang berfokus pada tren Vibe Coding bersama komunitas ruangBelajar.
committee.descEn: Leading the committee in organizing a technology talkshow focusing on the Vibe Coding trend with the ruangBelajar community.

committee.descId: Menyusun rangkaian acara, memandu jalannya malam keakraban, dan mengoordinasikan teknis kompetisi game internal.
committee.descEn: Arranging the event schedule, guiding the networking night, and coordinating the technical aspects of the internal game competition.

committee.descId: Menjaga kondusivitas, keamanan, dan ketertiban selama jalannya rangkaian pemilihan umum raya mahasiswa kampus.
committee.descEn: Maintaining safety, security, and order throughout the campus student general election series.

committee.descId: Bertanggung jawab atas penyusunan susunan acara (rundown), koordinasi pembicara, dan memastikan kelancaran teknis pelatihan TOEFL oleh UKM EC UTB.
committee.descEn: Responsible for timeline drafting (rundown), speaker coordination, and ensuring technical smoothness of TOEFL training by UKM EC UTB.
